text:
maria: Quick check — auditor Sam asked for artifacts that tie recent RBAC changes to audit logs and KMS access for Q4. Can we assemble a package (manifest + hashes) and a mapping to control IDs?
chris: Yep. I can pull rolebinding snapshots, PRs, and Splunk slices for the window. What exact timeframe and output format do they want? tarball or presigned URLs?
sam_auditor: Window: 2023-10-01 to 2023-12-31. We need a manifest listing each artifact, SHA256 hashes, and a short mapping doc linking artifacts to controls (access-change, logging, key-usage). Minimize PII in logs. Prefer a single presigned tarball + a CSV index.
ria: For KMS, do you need envelope key usage (DEK unwrap events) or just CMK admin/rotate events? We log both but DEK usage is only surfaced in service logs (not KMS API).
maria: Sam said: show when a particular role-binding was added/removed and any KMS decrypts by service accounts within 24h of those RBAC changes.
chris: Got it. Plan: 1) role-binding PRs and cluster events 2) cloudtrail/Splunk slice for KMS and iam events 3) service-account activity window 4) manifest + sha256sums. I'll run these queries and stage in the audit bucket.
ria: Splunk query I'll use (tweak as needed):

```
index=infra_logs (eventType=IAMChange OR eventType=KMSDecrypt) earliest="10/01/2023:00:00:00" latest="12/31/2023:23:59:59" | stats count by user, eventType, destKeyId, host, _time
```

ria: And to export KMS key metadata (aws cli):

```
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms describe-key --key-id {} --output json
```

chris: For cluster RBAC snapshots I'll grab `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o yaml` at the nearest commit sha of the PR merge; we keep git snapshots in infra-repo. Example extraction cmd: `git show <merge-commit>:manifests/rbac.yaml`
chris: Packaging details: I'll create s3://redwood-audit-collect/pack-1712346789/ with files: manifest.csv, sha256sums.txt, pr-list.csv, splunk-slice.gz, kms-meta.json, rbacsnap-<sha>.yaml. Then presign a tarball.
maria: Add chain-of-custody notes: who pulled data, runbook step id, and ticket link. Sam wants who approved the export.
oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: <https://tracker.redwood/INC-2026-0048|INC-2026-0048> (for packaging and handoff)
sam_auditor: We also need a short explanation for any logged KMS decrypts by automation accounts — e.g., batch jobs or model-hosting nodes — indicate whether DEKs are customer data or system-only.
chris: I'll annotate each decrypt with the principal and correlate with job runs. If a decrypt correlates with an RBAC add/remove within 24h, I'll flag it in the CSV with `related_change=true`.
maria: One more ask from compliance: retention proof for logs (how long we keep raw events). Ria, can you add retention policy pointers (Splunk index retention + S3 lifecycle) to the manifest?
ria: Yep. I'll include index TTLs and S3 lifecycle rules and a short snippet: `s3://redwood-logs -> lifecycle: transition to GLACIER after 90d, expire after 540d`. Also include Splunk index settings export.
sam_auditor: Good. Last piece: sign the manifest with a PGP key or provide s3 presigned URLs with timebox? We need verifiable integrity.
maria: We'll do both: manifest.json + sha256 and generate a small PGP-signed statement. Also provide a presigned tarball (7 days).
chris: ETA: I'll have the initial package and index CSV staged by EOD PST tomorrow. I'll post presigned links in the ticket and ping here.
sam_auditor: Thanks — please mark any redactions so we can validate completeness.
maria: Will do. Filing checklist in the ticket now. :thumbsup:
chris: starting queries now, will post progress updates.
ria: sharing Splunk saved search after first run.
maria: thanks team.
chris: ack.
